c_suite_organization.description: The complete executive leadership and operational structure required to take a software idea from inception to market launch, including key performance indicators (KPIs) for each role.

c_level.description: Owner of the business vision and model. Secures funding, sets global strategy, and coordinates all other C-level executives.
kpis: Runway & Funding Secured (Months of operational runway)
Customer Acquisition Cost to Lifetime Value Ratio (CAC:LTV > 1:3)
Net Promoter Score (NPS) / Overall Market Value

c_level.description: Responsible for product definition and user value. Transforms the strategic business vision into concrete features, user flows, and product design.
kpis: Product-Market Fit Score
User Activation Rate (% of users completing core action)
Feature Adoption Rate & Retention Rate (MoM)

level_1_management.responsibilities: Writes detailed feature specifications, prioritizes the product backlog, and coordinates timelines between design and engineering teams.
kpis: On-Time Feature Delivery (% of roadmap commitments met)
Product Backlog Health (Ready-to-dev tasks available)
User Churn Rate reduction per feature release

level_2_execution.responsibilities: Conducts user research, creates wireframes (UX), and designs the final high-fidelity visual interfaces (UI) and design systems.
kpis: Task Completion Rate (UX usability testing success)
Drop-off Rate at Key Funnel Steps (e.g., onboarding)
Design System Consistency (% of reusable components used)

c_level.description: The technical mastermind. Selects the technology stack, designs the high-level architecture, and ensures the system is stable, scalable, and performant.
kpis: Platform Uptime & Availability (e.g., 99.9% availability)
Infrastructure Cost per Active User
Engineering Velocity & Resource Efficiency

level_1_management.responsibilities: Oversees the development team, guides core architectural choices, ensures code quality, and reviews technical documentation.
kpis: Sprint Velocity / Story Points completed
Cycle Time (Time from code branch to production deployment)
Code Review Turnaround Time

level_2_execution.responsibilities: Write clean, maintainable code to build user-facing components (Frontend) and databases, APIs, and business logic (Backend).
kpis: Deployment Frequency (Production pushes per week)
Code Churn Rate (% of code rewritten shortly after commit)
Technical Debt Ratio (Remediation time vs. development time)

level_2_execution.responsibilities: Executes automated and manual tests to catch bugs and guarantee software functionality before release.
kpis: Defect Leakage Rate (% of bugs found by users in production)
Automated Test Coverage %
Time to Detect and Verify Bug Fixes

c_level.description: The protector. Ensures 'Security by Design' across the codebase, infrastructure, and user data while maintaining legal regulatory compliance.
kpis: Compliance Audit Score (GDPR, SOC2, HIPAA readiness)
Mean Time to Detect / Respond to Incidents (MTTD / MTTR)
Zero Critical Vulnerabilities in Production

level_1_execution.responsibilities: Secures production environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), manages firewalls, automates patch management, and monitors vulnerabilities.
kpis: Time to Patch Critical Vulnerabilities
Phishing/Security Simulation Success Rate
Access Control Audit Logs Defect Count

c_level.description: Responsible for growth, customer acquisition, and market positioning. Drives the go-to-market strategy to bring users to the software.
kpis: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reduction MoM
Total Lead/User Volume Growth (MQLs/SQLs)
Share of Voice (SOV) / Brand Awareness metrics

level_1_execution.responsibilities: Manages paid acquisition (Google/Meta Ads), handles SEO strategy, and analyzes user funnel conversion metrics.
kpis: Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
Landing Page Conversion Rate (%)
Organic Search Traffic Growth (SEO)

level_1_execution.responsibilities: Crafts compelling text for the landing page, ads, email sequences, and social media to communicate product value clearly.
kpis: Ad Click-Through Rate (CTR)
Email Open and Click Rates (Drip campaigns)
Content Engagement Rate (Time on page / Social shares)
